rows.description: Sunshine fork: an enhanced sunshine, a self-hosted game streaming host for Moonlight with HDR10/HDR Vivid, virtual displays, advanced audio, optimized encoders, and a modern control panel.
Use an iPhone, iPad, or spare Mac as a true second display for your Mac without restrictions.
✨ Perfect virtual display for game streaming

Every display control macOS hides, in one menu bar app: sharp HiDPI/Retina scaling (no more blurry or tiny text), DDC brightness and volume, Extra Brightness past 100%, presets, virtual displays. Free and open source, a no-cost alternative to BetterDisplay and Lunar.

Effortlessly create virtual displays in Windows, capable of supporting various resolutions and refresh rates, suitable for remote control or graphics card spoofing.在win中轻松创建支持多种分辨率和刷新率的虚拟显示器，可用于远程控制或显卡欺骗。
